name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1881: He said the tracker is stuck when he sits on it. It refetched on a flat 120 second interval, so nothing on screen moved between polls and a working tracker looked exactly like a dead one, and that interval is unaligned to a rotation that turns on the hour and the half hour, so he could spend two minutes reading a zone that had already ended. A comment claimed the board refetched six seconds after the turn and no such code has ever existed. Now a one second clock counts down to the next turn, the fetch chases the boundary with retries at plus 8, 25 and 60 seconds because the feed lags its own rotation, and the two minute poll stays as the floor.
